scripts.dev: node scripts/build-blog.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && concurrently -k -n posts,docs,build,serve -c yellow,magenta,blue,green "node scripts/build-blog.mjs --watch" "node scripts/build-docs.mjs --watch" "vite build --watch" "vite --open"
scripts.build: node scripts/build-blog.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && vite build
